tool.note: Free anonymous chat. One session; every question was asked in a fresh chat, so answers are independent.

labels.found: The answer names tinystudio.io and describes it correctly.
labels.wrong: The answer describes tinystudio.io wrongly or confuses it with a namesake.

questions.name: What they do
questions.question: What does TinyStudio.io do?
questions.answer: TinyStudio.io appears to offer a “leak audit” and related services for websites — specifically, identifying what keeps visitors from committing (e.g., unanswered pre-purchase questions, pricing leaks, friction in the enquiry flow) and then fixing the highest-impact pages. More simply: it checks a site's key conversion points, writes up the named issues with fixes, and can implement the fixes as part of a short engagement.
questions.page: The homepage leads with “Most of them leave before they ever get in touch” and the audit page with “We read your page as a customer with intent reads it.” The leak-audit framing the assistant described is stated on the page in plain language.

questions.name: Who it is for
questions.question: Who is TinyStudio.io for?
questions.answer: TinyStudio.io appears to be for Mac users who want to automatically generate subtitles for videos, using an AI workflow based on Whisper / whisper.cpp.
questions.page: No sentence on the homepage states who TinyStudio is for. The industry list sits mid-page inside the study band, and the homepage copy never names a buyer. With nothing unambiguous to cite, the assistant answered about the nearest namesake.
questions.fix: One sentence on the homepage stating who TinyStudio is for, with the full domain spelled out beside the name, so an assistant has an unambiguous line to cite instead of the nearest namesake.
questions.note: The assistant cited tinystudio.ai — a different business — and never named tinystudio.io.

questions.name: The price
questions.question: How much does TinyStudio.io cost?
questions.answer: I can't find a reliable public pricing page for TinyStudio.io from available search results, so I can't tell you the cost with confidence. If you paste the pricing URL (or a screenshot/text of the plans), I'll calculate the exact monthly/annual total and summarize the tiers for you.
questions.page: The audit page states “the desk runs at $2,500 a month on a three-month minimum, with a delivery guarantee behind it” and pricing.html shows $2,500 with the delivery terms. The assistant retrieved no price and no pricing page.
questions.fix: State the price once, in one sentence, in the first screen of the homepage, using the same wording as the terms page. The figure exists; it is not in a line an assistant finds first.

questions.name: Who runs it
questions.question: Who runs TinyStudio.io?
questions.answer: I couldn't find reliable public info identifying who runs TinyStudio.io. It may be a different “Tiny Studio” site (there are several similarly named domains), so if you share what you mean by TinyStudio.io (e.g., its company page/about page or a screenshot of the site header/footer), I can pinpoint the owner/operator.
questions.page: No public page names the operator. The specimen document is signed “Nish”; the homepage and audit page name nobody.
questions.fix: A one-line byline in the footer naming who runs TinyStudio — the specimen already signs its documents “Nish”; the public pages name nobody.

questions.name: The guarantees
questions.question: Does TinyStudio.io guarantee results?
questions.answer: TinyStudio.io doesn't guarantee “results” like rankings, customers, or bookings. What it does say it guarantees is delivery timing for its month-one work: if the month-one deliverables aren't in your hands within 14 working days of Day 0, month one is refunded in full; also, it states it does not guarantee more customers, and that it has no revenue/ranking/booking guarantees.
questions.page: Every page footer states “No revenue, ranking or booking guarantees. Only the work.” and pricing.html states the delivery guarantee: fourteen working days, month one refunded in full. The assistant's answer matched the published terms.

questions.name: The contact
questions.question: How do I contact TinyStudio.io?
questions.answer: I found a couple of different “Tiny Studio” sites, each with its own contact details: Mr. Tiny Studio (mrtinystudio.com): mr.tinystudio@gmail.com; The Tiny Studio (thetiny-studio.com): catarinabaptistam@gmail.com; The Tiny Studio (thetinstudio.co.uk / thetinystudio): hello@thetinystudio.co.uk. If you share which exact site/app you mean by TinyStudio.io (or what you're trying to contact them about), I can point you to the correct email/contact form.
questions.page: hello@tinystudio.io appears on the Agent Desk page, in offer.md and llms.txt — but not on the homepage or audit page footers. The assistant answered with the contact details of three other businesses.
questions.fix: Put hello@tinystudio.io in the homepage and audit page footers, next to the existing signature line. The address exists; it is not on the pages an assistant cites.
